glosses: Fluid that exits the body through pores in the skin usually due to physical stress and/or high temperature for the purpose of regulating body temperature and removing certain compounds from the circulation.
The state of one who is sweating; diaphoresis.

examples.text: Just thinking about the interview tomorrow puts me into a nervous sweat.

glosses: Hard work; toil.
Moisture issuing from any substance.
